**THE GLYPHIC CHECKSUM (Document 208)** is a specification by Lee Sharks, deposited 1 February 2026, formalising the checksum as a **Logotic Operator (🔐)** within the University Moon Base Media Lab framework.

Its position in the stack is stated precisely: Logotic Programming v0.4 establishes *conditions of intelligibility* and Symbolon addresses fused documentary objects; the Glyphic Checksum supplies **verification** — the operation by which an object can be confirmed to be what its glyph declares.

The specification is the theoretical ground of the AXN identifier system, where a six-emoji display hash derived from content makes identity checkable without reading the work. **#1303** deposits the same 15,832-character specification under three voices as Document 209, and the two stand as duplicate witnesses rather than a version sequence.
